_note: Greek stems per tracked thread, for pipeline/audit_thread_coverage.py. Match is accent-insensitive, lowercase, SUBSTRING (augment/reduplication defeat prefix matching, e.g. akolouth- vs ēkolouth-). A word matches the thread if its accent-stripped form contains any string in `stems` and is not listed in `exclude`. `exclude`: accent-stripped whole word-forms that a stem catches but that belong to a different lexeme (homographs). `phrase: true`: a fixed multi-word title (son-of-man, apo-tote, ...) with no single stem — the audit skips it; its coverage is maintained by hand. A thread in data/threads.json with NO entry here is reported by the audit as undefined — add it one at a time, running the audit to see what each stem drags in and tuning `exclude`. Greek source: MatthewSBLGNT.txt at the repo root.
